about: Facts for the practice 2 checks, computed from the rules in CONTRACT.md and docs/log-formats.md on the raw files, without scan_id and expires_at. 'trees' are log roots the checks build in temporary folders: each entry is a file or link under the tree's folder, and 'root' names the log root inside it. Entry kinds: 'symlink' (a link with that relative target), 'copy' and 'gunzip' (a file of s3_logs, as it is or decompressed), 'bytes' (UTF-8 text as it is), and 'text' (lines joined with a newline after each; 'fill' replaces {fill} with 'count' copies of 'char'; the block is written 'repeat' times, with {n} replaced by 1, 2, ... when 'numbered' is true; 'gzip' compresses it, 'cut_half' then keeps the first half of the compressed bytes; 'size' extends the file to that length). In arguments, '{root}' is the log root's absolute path. A group_lines call scans with 'scan' first; 'group_id' is the group it asks for, and '{scan_id}' in an error stands for the scan's id. A call has 'result' or 'error' (the exact tool error text). 'compare' limits what a check compares. 'formats_document' is the triage://formats content.
